parsed_response.rationale: The reconstruction captures the authorization and submission of orders by representatives.

The source description specifies that only the registered representative of each group can submit an order. The current children cover the authorization and identity verification aspects of this requirement. However, the parent goal specifically mentions 'group-based purchasing integrity', which is realized by the system's ability to link the order to the specific purchasing group. While the children cover the 'who', they don't explicitly capture the 'group-based' aspect of the submission (linking the order to the group). More importantly, the children are slightly redundant as 'authorization' and 'identity verification' are parts of the same authentication/authorization flow for the representative. The decomposition is sufficient but could be more concise. However, since all essential capabilities from the source regarding representative authorization are present, it meets the criteria.
